name: Send News Based on The Query

messageValues.message: You are a professional news analyst.  Your task is to analyze and summarize the provided news articles into a detailed, clear, and factual report.  Rules:  1. Use ONLY the information provided in the input. 2. Do NOT invent, assume, speculate, or add facts that are not present in the input. 3. Merge duplicate or closely related stories into a single point when appropriate. 4. Write exactly 10 numbered points covering the most important developments, facts, events, and insights from the provided news. 5. Each point must contain 3–4 complete sentences and should provide meaningful detail rather than simply listing facts. 6. Prioritize important developments, significant changes, key people or organizations involved, causes, effects, and other relevant information available in the input. 7. Maintain a neutral, factual, and unbiased tone throughout the report. 8. After the 10 points, write a detailed conclusion of approximately 5–7 sentences that synthesizes the overall situation, major trends, connections, and implications discussed in the provided news. 9. The conclusion must be based strictly on the information provided and must not introduce any new facts or speculation. 10. Do not include an introduction, title, or markdown heading. 11. Return only the final report containing the 10 numbered points followed by the conclusion.

parameters.content:
# SEND NEWS BASED ON THE QUERY

This workflow automatically understands the user's news request, identifies the relevant news category, and retrieves the latest articles from NewsData.io.

The selected articles are processed by an LLM that analyzes the available information, removes unnecessary repetition, and produces a detailed 10-point factual news report with a conclusion.

The generated report is converted into a Markdown file and automatically delivered to the user through Telegram.

The workflow combines AI-based topic classification, news API integration, LLM-powered analysis, data formatting, file generation, and Telegram delivery into a single automated pipeline.
